name: Dorje Chang Institute
teacherAccess: Resident Geshe and visiting FPMT teachers
retreatOptions: Periodic retreats per program calendar; long/short-term shared-facility accommodation
about: New Zealand's oldest Tibetan Buddhist center (established 1976), on 2.5 acres with a meditation hall, stupa, and grounds bordering a reserve. Functions primarily as an urban dharma center with dormitory/hut accommodation rather than a rural retreat destination -- included with that caveat since it does host periodic residential retreats on its own land.
